title: Ganger
description:

Be part of a team that make a real difference within the communities we serve. Our mission drives us, and we want you to be part of the journey.

Experience Western Downs It's the people that make it!

The Opportunity

The Ganger is responsible for providing a range of services to ensure the sustainability of community and council infrastructure aimed at enhancing the liveability and environment of our growing region.

The purpose of this role is to provide a high level of support to the Works Supervisor in undertaking a leading role whilst performing construction and maintenance tasks.

About Yourself

A person in this position will need to hold a relevant Certificate III in Civil Construction or willingness to complete such qualification in a required timeframe, OR be able to demonstrate equivalent related experience.

It is also highly desirable for the successful candidate to have:

  • Verification of Competency in the operation of various types of plant
  • OH&S Construction Safety Induction White Card
  • Open âLRâ class drivers licence required or willingness to obtain
  • Heavy Rigid (HR) Queensland Drivers Licence would be desirable

The Benefits Of Working For WDRC

Work / life balance

We understand the importance of balance. Enjoy flexible work arrangements and wellness programs designed to keep you at your best.

Superannuation

In addition to your annual salary, Council will contribute twelve (12) per cent, including the superannuation guarantee contribution.

Growth Opportunities

We invest in your growth. Whether itâs skill development, mentorship, or career advancement, weâve got you covered.

Access to Corporate Health Plan

Take care of yourself and join one of our Corporate Health Plans to improve life.

Health & Wellbeing program and Mental Health Support

Change your lifestyle and live better with healthy ideas. Be your best possible self with provided support and information.

Access to free Employee Assistance Program & confidential counselling

Reach out to someone confidentially if you are experiencing any concerns or problems.

Salary Packaging Available

Restructure your salary to work for you to pay for everyday living expenses such as Motor Vehicles, Superannuation, Remote Area Housing (Rent), Fuel, Gas and Electricity.

Allowances Available (if applicable)

Allowances such as Locality Allowance may be applicable to your position.

You will receive 17.5% leave loading on top of your base rate of pay, while you are on Annual Leave.

Uniforms and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) provided.

Job security in a local government position

Feel secure working for an organisation who believes in strong foundations of respect, balance, communication, teamwork, accountability and leadership.

Relocation assistance of up to $5,000 may be provided to the preferred

candidate if relocating to the Western Downs Region.

Living & Working In The Western Downs

https://www.westerndownsqueensland.com.au/

title: Director Proposal Management Defense and Space
description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Proposal Management to lead Defense and Space proposal operations supporting U.S. Government, OEM Defense, International Defense, and Space customers. This senior leadership role is responsible for driving winning proposal strategies, leading high-performing teams, improving proposal processes, and ensuring successful execution of complex RFQ, RFI, and RFP opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a transformational leader with deep expertise in proposal management, government contracting, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement. This individual will work closely with executive leadership, sales, engineering, finance, and operations teams to secure new business and retain existing customers.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a diverse team of proposal management professionals.
  • Conduct performance evaluations, coaching, and career development planning.
  • Establish performance metrics and productivity goals.
  • Develop succession plans and build organizational capability for future growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Process Improvement & Operations Excellence

  • Identify and implement process improvement initiatives to increase proposal quality, efficiency, and responsiveness.
  • Leverage automation and emerging technologies, including generative AI, to improve proposal operations.
  • Monitor key operational metrics and present results to executive leadership.
  • Improve proposal turnaround times and on-time delivery performance.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Engineering, Finance, Contracts, and Program Management teams to develop compelling solutions.
  • Facilitate executive reviews, proposal kickoffs, and compliance reviews.
  • Analyze risks, opportunities, and business impacts to support strategic decision-making.
  • Present proposal performance, business insights, and organizational recommendations to senior executives.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of proposal management experience in Aerospace, Defense, Government Contracting, or related industries.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience managing professional teams.
  • Strong understanding of RFQ, RFI, and RFP processes.
  • Knowledge of FAR and government proposal compliance requirements.
  • Experience leading cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Proven success managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelorâs Degree, Management, Operations, or related field
  • APMP membership or certification.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com and data analytics tools.
  • Experience implementing process automation and AI-enabled business solutions.
  • Background supporting Defense, Aerospace, Aviation, or Space customers.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Proposal Management
  • Project Management
  • Business Process Improvement
  • Executive Communication
  • Relationship Building
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Planning & Scheduling
  • Risk Management
  • Team Development
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Customer Focus

What Success Looks Like

  • Increased proposal win rates and business growth.
  • Improved proposal productivity, quality, and turnaround times.
  • Strong employee engagement and talent development.
  • Consistent on-time proposal delivery
  • Effective implementation of process improvements and operational efficiencies

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

Benefits

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
